Arm-vs-arm comparisons stay valid — all arms share this kernel — but a promoted arm must still survive the earlier live entry, and that caveat is attached to every surfaced verdict.

findings.claim: entry-8pct and vol-4x are reported with screen_dWR=0.0pp, the same value as the provably inert placebo.
findings.problem: Their quoted levels are screen_wr=51.807 (n=498) and 51.487 (n=874) against control 50.128 (n=1560), so a zero delta cannot be the difference of the numbers shown. Either the delta is computed on a paired subset that is never reported with its own n, or it is simply not being computed for arms whose scored sample differs from control. Any reader comparing these arms to control is reading a level, which the methodology explicitly forbids, and the 0.0pp field silently makes two arms look decision-neutral when their reported win rates are not.

findings.claim: Checkbox paired_population: 'Every arm scored on identical events' — green, 4848 events in the shared window, every arm has seen all of them.
findings.problem: Seen is not scored. screen_n ranges from 498 (entry-8pct) to 1563 (hold-12h) against control's 1560, and declined runs 47 for most arms but 79 for entry-8pct and 59 for vol-4x. The check establishes a shared detection stream, not a shared scored population, yet its title asserts the stronger claim. Arms that decline different subsets are being compared across different populations — the project's own PM failure mode — while a critical checkbox certifies the opposite.

findings.claim: Checkbox backfill_cannot_promote: 'Only live-tape evidence can promote' — ok=true, detail '0 surfaced arm(s); none promoted from a screen'.
findings.problem: This is green because nothing has ever been surfaced, not because the promotion path was exercised and refused. A guard with zero candidates has demonstrated nothing about its own behaviour; it will read green identically whether the rule is enforced or absent. Given that every arm's headline statistics are screen numbers built on 4764 backfill events versus 84 live events, this is the one guard whose failure would matter most, and it is untested.

findings.claim: Mechanism-class diversity is enforced in code, one class per running arm.
findings.problem: Two running arms carry class=liquidity_filter (placebo with min_price=1e-12, and vol-4x) and two carry class=entry_trigger (control with changed={}, and entry-8pct). Either the enforcement is not running or control and placebo are exempt without that exemption being stated anywhere in the context. It also means control and placebo are consuming two of the six mechanism-class slots, which shrinks the number of real hypotheses that can run concurrently without anyone having decided that.

findings.claim: Measured ghost arrival = 24.9 control trades/day, with confirm planned n=600.
findings.problem: The live tape shows events by tier live=84 and control live_n=23 for the whole arena. An arrival rate of 24.9 control trades/day is not reconcilable with 23 accumulated control trades unless 'ghost arrival' counts something other than scored control trades, and the context never says which. The n=600 confirm target and any statement about how long confirm will take rest entirely on that rate; at the observed live_n of 23 the timeline implied is different by orders of magnitude. Related lemmas in the graveyard quote 25.6, 25.2 and 25.0 control trades/day for the same quantity, so the figure is not stable either.

findings.claim: Checkbox no_lookahead: 'Detection is look-ahead free' — critical, ok=true, re-detected 108 events on truncated history across 6 coins, no mismatches.
findings.problem: The verification covers 108 events on 6 coins against a dataset of 4848 shared events, 4764 backfill events and 176 coins. A clean result on roughly two percent of events and six of 176 coins does not establish the property for the population the arena scores on, particularly since the five kernel_agreement misses are concentrated in specific names (four BOME, one BANANA) and the coins actually re-detected are not listed. The check should either report the coins covered or its coverage fraction alongside the green.
